requirements_summary: SMB helpdesk vendor wants hosted API to replace expensive in-house third-party LLM service. Must be self-serve friendly, low setup friction. SLOs: median latency <350ms per generation for chat, throughput ~3k messages/hour during peaks. Cost target: reduce current per-ticket inference spend by >=20%. token_audit_findings: Initial audit (Mar 6) — 3 anonymized threads: avg input+system tokens ~1,120, output ~240. High system-prompts and repeated KB dumps. Candidate savings: 18-30% via prompt compression + dynamic context windowing; additional 10% via batching and reuse of embeddings for doc-search. Recommend sample: compact system template, embed-only top-3 docs, client-side chunking for long KBs.
